historical_parent.role: DIAGNOSTIC_INPUT_ONLY; V19 remains historically unchanged and is not a scientific endpoint.

original_decision_rule.combination_materiality: material if model-preference portability is material OR both parameter-location and contour geometry are material

contour_overlap.method: empirical weighted two-dimensional posterior/profile overlap; no Gaussian compression

final_classification.MATERIAL_SCIENTIFIC_PORTABILITY_DIFFEREN: FULL material AND materiality survives every required valid leave-one-out test
final_classification.MIXED_DATASET_CONDITIONAL: at least one valid required combination is material and at least one valid required combination is non-material
final_classification.SCIENTIFIC_DIFFERENCE_COLLAPSES: FULL and every valid leave-one-out are non-material in parameter location, have substantial contour overlap, and have portable EDE/LCDM conclusions

model_preference.portability_material_if: arms occupy different categories AND abs(DeltaChi2_A-DeltaChi2_B)>=2

parameter_location.material_if: D_H0>=1 OR D_fEDE>=1 OR at least two eligible primary cosmological coordinates have D>=1
parameter_location.weak_identification_rule: log10z_c and thetai_scf cannot by themselves make parameter-location material when fEDE is weakly identified/prior dominated.

prospective_execution_strategy.best_fit_method: Cobaya minimize with Py-BOBYQA, multiple preregistered starts per within-arm model/data cell
prospective_execution_strategy.best_fit_role: within-arm LCDM-versus-EDE DeltaChi2 only; never cross-arm absolute objective subtraction
prospective_execution_strategy.cross_version_v19_chain_state_reuse: FORBIDDEN_AS_SAMPLER_STATE; V19 samples may be diagnostic/reference only.
prospective_execution_strategy.profile_or_overlap: Use weighted nested posterior samples and/or preregistered profile construction for empirical (H0,fEDE) overlap; no single-Gaussian compression.
prospective_execution_strategy.reason: V19 shows non-converged separated ridges/modes/boundary structure and high-acceptance local transport; a sampler designed for multimodality and non-Gaussian contours is required instead of simply extending the same MCMC.

scientific_question: Can the original Q041 downstream-portability test be executed with a new preregistered convergence-robust inference strategy that exactly preserves the original scientific contract?
scope: Artifact-only V19 convergence/transport diagnosis plus prospective execution-mechanism selection. No Q041 cosmological classification is allowed.
